basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The candidates have to pay the prescribed application fee through NEFT in favor of “AIIMS KALYANI INTERNAL RESOURCES ACCOUNT” (Account No- 41277688529, IFSC Code- SBIN0063963, State Bank of India, AIIMS, Kalyani Branch). Application fee once remitted shall not be refunded under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 45 (Forty-Five) years as on the date of publishing this notification in Institute website.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior resident: MDS in the department of Dentistry

salary_details.pay_scale: Level 11 of the Pay Matrix of the Seventh Central Pay Commission + NPA for Medical Graduates
salary_details.senior resident: Rs.15,600-39,100+GP 6,600 (6th CPC) Level 11 of the Pay Matrix of the Seventh Central Pay Commission + NPA for Medical Graduates.
salary_details.details: Allowance and perks will be admissible as per the rules besides Pays & NPA (for medical candidates only).

selection_process: the Interview will be conducted after verifying the application and requisite documents of the candidates. The selection of the candidates will be based on the performance in the interview only.
how_to_apply: Visit the online application portal via the link provided on the official website.
Fill out the application form carefully and complete the choice filling.
Pay the application fee through NEFT using the specified bank details.
Keep all certificates scanned as PDF files, scanned photograph as an image file, scanned signature as an image file, and scanned payment receipt as a PDF file ready while filling the application.
Submit the online application up to 14.10.2026, 05:00 PM.
Download and save a copy of the application form.
Bring the application in prescribed format along with self-attested copies of certificates/documents on the day of interview.
important_instructions: No hard copy of the application would be accepted during online submission. The choice filling during the application process would be final and no changes can be made subsequently. Only eligible candidates would be allowed to appear for the interview as per the eligibility list to be uploaded in the Institute website. The post of Senior Resident will be regulated as per the provision of Central Residency Scheme and governed by CCS (Temporary Service) Rules. Applicants already in service shall have to produce No Objection Certificate from their present employer at the time of Interview. The post(s) is/are whole time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Canvassing of any kind will be a disqualification. No TA/DA/Accommodation will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by AIIMS Kalyani for engaging a Senior Resident (Non-Academic) on tenure basis in the Department of Dentistry.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacant seat available under the OBC category for Pedodontics & Preventive Dentistry.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MDS degree in the department of Dentistry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of publishing the notification on the Institute website, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for OBC candidates, while PWBD candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 26 October 2026 from 09:30 AM onward at the Academic Block -1, Ground Floor, Academic Section of AIIMS, Kalyani.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Selection is based on document verification and performance in the personal interview only.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The post carries pay under Level 11 of the Pay Matrix of the Seventh Central Pay Commission plus NPA for Medical Graduates.
